name: CTDHPD4341PriorAuthRule
title: CTDHP / HUSKY B — D4341 (Scaling & Root Planing) Requires Prior Authorization
description: Coverage-requirements rule for the Connecticut HUSKY B dental benefit (CTDHP). Fires at order-sign when a dental provider plans periodontal scaling and root planing (CDT D4341). Per the Connecticut administration model, this rule is surfaced/routed through Connie (the statewide HIE) with prior-authorization intake handled by the BeneCare ASO, while DTR/PAS evaluation and claims adjudication are performed by Gainwell Technologies (the DSS fiscal agent running CMAP). There is no dental MCO. This rule is not triggered by the covered-evaluation referral (UC03 Interaction 1); it fires only at the treatment visit (Interaction 3).

action.title: Flag PA required for D4341 (scaling and root planing)
